So this started last spring when my best friend and I planned a trip together. We saved for months, booked everything, and two weeks before we left she told me she was bringing her new boyfriend. I said it was fine but it wasn't. The whole trip I felt like a third wheel, and when I tried to talk about it she said I was being dramatic. Since then we barely speak, and now she's getting married and asked me to be a bridesmaid. I don't know if I'm angry, hurt, or just tired of pretending everything is okay between us.
